title: Explorer client
what: The client of the six operations, each done once: an engine search, a page read as words, a link preview, a page's markup, a picture and the engines' standing, failing in the wire error shape. Lives in src/client.rs.

title: Unit command
what: The bmo-explorer program: mcp serves the MCP server over the data root, openapi prints the contract document. Lives in src/main.rs and src/lib.rs.

title: MCP server and harness plugin
what: The MCP server bmo-explorer mcp starts, its six explorer_ tools each a thin call of one client function, and the bmo-explorer skill. Lives in src/mcp.rs and plugin/skills/bmo-explorer/.

title: OpenAPI contract
what: The OpenAPI 3.1 document written from the client's types and the MCP server's tool table, kept as docs/openapi.json and held to the code by a test. Lives in src/openapi.rs.
